FERNA ACCOUNT SUPPORT

Account and data deletion

You can request deletion of your Ferna sign-in account by email, even if you no longer have access to the app.

Request deletion of your Ferna account

Ferna does not currently provide an account-deletion control in the app. You can request deletion at any time using the email steps below.

  1. Email abhijeet@oneleverlabs.com from the email address associated with your Ferna account.
  2. Use the subject line Ferna account deletion.
  3. We’ll verify that the request is from the account holder. After verification, we’ll delete the Ferna sign-in account and review any account-linked service records for deletion where applicable.

We’ll confirm by email when the request has been handled. We don’t state a fixed completion time here; timing can depend on identity verification and any service provider involved. If you can’t email us from the address on the account, write to us and we’ll explain how to verify ownership. Never send us your password or sign-in verification code.

What deletion removes

Deleting your Ferna account removes the sign-in account associated with the verified request. Ferna garden data—such as plant profiles, care schedules, journal entries, and app preferences—is stored locally on your device and is not currently synchronized to a Ferna cloud garden. Account deletion does not erase that local data. To remove it, delete the data in the app if available, clear Ferna’s app storage in your device settings, or uninstall the app. Uninstalling or clearing app data may permanently remove local garden information.

Ferna does not currently offer in-app subscriptions. If you have a purchase or subscription through an app store, manage or cancel it through that store; deleting a Ferna account does not itself cancel store billing.

Other information and service providers

Plant photos and related text that you submit for identification or diagnosis are sent to Ferna’s AI backend, which uses OpenAI to process the request. Account deletion does not automatically delete prior requests from provider systems. Those providers may retain or process request information under their own terms and the applicable service configuration. We don’t promise deletion from systems we don’t control.

If you enabled optional analytics, analytics information is handled under Firebase’s retention controls and policies. We’ll review account-linked records in services we operate as part of a verified request. Some records held by service providers may remain under their own retention policies.

Need help?

Contact abhijeet@oneleverlabs.com. Please include “Ferna account deletion” in the subject. See our Ferna Privacy Policy for more details about information handling.
